subject: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs
parts:
Dear Shiny gurus!

in my ui.r I have numeric inputs, e.g.: 

...
numericInput("myseed", "Specify the Random Seed:", 1),
...


Is there a way to restrict a possible range of a given numeric input? E.g., not allow the user to select a value below X and above Y?

Thanks  a lot!
Dimitri

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs
parts:
?shiny::numericInput
Usage
  numericInput(inputId, label, value, min = NA, max = NA,
    step = NA)
 
Arguments

inputId
Input variable to assign the control's value to

label
Display label for the control

value
Initial value

min
Minimum allowed value

max
Maximum allowed value

step
Interval to use when stepping between min and max

messages.subject: Re: restrict the rang of possible numeric inputs
parts:
Indeed, when I do: 
numericInput("myseed", "Specify the Random Seed:", 5, min=1),

then when I use the arrow next to the number it does not allow me to go down below 1.
But then user could still manually enter some number below the minimum and there is no error. What number will be used by shiny in such a case (when the user specifies a value outside the allowed range)?
Thank you!
